official: 町田市手数料条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年3月定例会（第1回） 議案一覧

name: マンション再生などの申請対象を変更
summary: 既存建築物の道路に関する制限緩和や、マンションの建替えに伴う特例許可の申請には、条例で手数料が定められています。この議案では、申請の根拠となる規定や、マンション関連の申請対象を改めます。手数料額は、既存建築物の各申請が1件28,000円、マンション関連が1件160,000円です。
changes: 既存建築物の敷地と道路の関係に関する申請の根拠条項を、政令第137条の12第6項から第11項に改める
既存建築物の道路内の建築制限に関する申請の根拠条項を、政令第137条の12第7項から第12項に改める
マンション関連の申請対象を、要除却認定マンションの建替えから、要除却等認定マンションの建替え・更新に伴う容積率または各部分の高さの特例許可に改める
who: 既存建築物の道路関係の制限緩和を申請する人
マンションの建替え・更新に伴う特例許可を申請する人

en.name: Changes applications covered for condominium rebuilding and other matters
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Machida City Fee Ordinance
en.summary: The ordinance sets fees for applications to ease road-related restrictions on existing buildings and for special permits accompanying condominium rebuilding. This bill revises the provisions that form the basis for these applications and the types of condominium-related applications covered. The fees are ¥28,000 per application for existing-building matters and ¥160,000 per condominium-related application.
changes: Changes the legal basis for applications concerning the relationship between existing buildings' sites and roads from paragraph 6 to paragraph 11 of Article 137-12 of the Cabinet Order
Changes the legal basis for applications concerning restrictions on building within roads for existing buildings from paragraph 7 to paragraph 12 of Article 137-12 of the Cabinet Order

Changes the condominium-related applications covered from rebuilding condominiums certified as requiring demolition to applications for special permission for floor-area ratios or the height of each part in connection with rebuilding or renewal of condominiums certified as requiring demolition, etc.
who: People applying to ease restrictions concerning the relationship between existing buildings' sites and roads
People applying to ease restrictions on building within roads for existing buildings
People applying for special permission in connection with condominium rebuilding or renewal
